observedContradiction: The frozen one-bit divisor grammar exactly solves distinct-prime parity but fails squarefree and Möbius-positive external targets.

preciseMechanismHypothesis.name: Multiplicity-Sensitive Structural Memory
preciseMechanismHypothesis.definition: A structural sweep retains an independent accumulator plus a generic bit indicating that the same structural event repeated within the current local unit, allowing the program to preserve multiplicity information without target-specific concepts.
preciseMechanismHypothesis.antiLeakage: No SQUAREFREE, MOBIUS, OMEGA, or target-specific output primitive is admitted.
